raid.label: Raid-ready, Phase 1
raid.notes: The same Phase 1 raid context for every spec: one group of each class brings its buffs and debuffs, each spec adds the consumables its role uses, no world buffs (Forever has none), the default 180 second encounter. Where a buff has a talented form, the plain version is used unless the live talent tree carries the talent and a raid would take it; none of the improved forms qualified. Blessing of Kings is left out: the live paladin trees do not grant it, and the engine applies it to Alliance characters only, so the two factions would differ. Windfury Totem is the engine's main-hand imbue Windfury. The engine applies Blessing of Might, Blessing of Wisdom and Sanctity Aura to Alliance characters only, and Strength of Earth, Grace of Air and Mana Spring Totem to Horde characters only, so each faction's raid entry carries the half its side can use until the fork drops that gate. Nothing from Ahn'Qiraj or Naxxramas is used.
